title: Classical 3-manifold theory — Question 9.4
exact_target: Strengthen the lamination constructions for non-torus alternating knots so every nontrivial surgery can be filled using an even-sided region and monkey saddles.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10300037 (AMR-102-0037). CC BY 4.0.
